tools.name: plan.create
tools.description: Create an active project plan. Plan items use status tbd, done, or wont_do. Use this near the start of substantive work, then keep it current with plan.set_item_status and plan.update.

targetAgent.description: Agent to nudge when the active plan has remaining tbd items. Defaults to the coordinator.

itemsText.description: One plan item per line. Lines starting with '-' or a number are accepted.

instructions.description: Optional extra instructions shown in continuation nudges.

replaceActive.description: Replace the current active incomplete plan.

nudgeCooldownMs.description: Minimum time between plan continuation nudges.

maxNudges.description: Maximum continuation nudges for this plan. 0 means no limit.

tools.name: plan.status
tools.description: Show the active plan, item statuses, and recent archived plans.

includeArchived.description: Include archived completed or abandoned plans.

tools.name: plan.update
tools.description: Update active plan metadata or append/replace plan items. Do not use this to mark progress; use plan.set_item_status for tbd/done/wont_do changes.

instructions.description: New extra instructions for continuation nudges.

itemsText.description: Plan items to append or use as replacement, one per line.

maxNudges.description: Maximum continuation nudges. 0 means no limit.

tools.name: plan.set_item_status
tools.description: Set a plan item to tbd, done, or wont_do. Call this after each meaningful step so the active plan reflects reality.

itemId.description: Plan item id such as item_1. Use itemIndex if easier.

tools.name: plan.close
tools.description: Archive the active plan after completion, or abandon it explicitly. Completed plans require every item to be done or wont_do.

status.description: How to close the active plan.

webui.title: Active plan
webui.description: Inspect active plan items, statuses, nudges, and recent archived plans.

webui.title: Create plan
webui.description: Create a new active plan with one item per line.

targetAgent.description: Agent to nudge. Defaults to coordinator.

webui.title: Update plan
webui.description: Update active plan metadata or append/replace items.

webui.title: Set plan item status
webui.description: Mark an item tbd, done, or wont_do.

itemId.description: Plan item id such as item_1.

webui.title: Close plan
webui.description: Archive the active plan as done or abandoned.
